name: get_reference
description: Return the REFERENCE image(s) the user is trying to match — the ones they dropped into the MCP Copilot panel in Blockbench, or that you loaded with load_reference — as inline images so you can actually SEE what to build. Call this FIRST whenever a reference is involved, and re-look during the build. Optionally pass `name`/`id` for a specific one.

id.description: Reference id to fetch (omit for all).

name.description: Reference name to fetch (omit for all).
